# iran-mcp

> 77 MCP servers (994 tools) that let AI agents search and compare Iranian websites: Digikala, Torob, Basalam, Technolife, MasterKala, Baneh, Shopino, Banimode, Divar, Khanoumi, Asal Banoo, Snappfood, Okala, Tapsi Food, MrBilit, Flytoday, Jabama, Otaghak, Paziresh24, Doctoreto, Taaghche, Fidibo, 30book, Maktabkhooneh courses, Snapp! Shop, Cafe Bazaar and Myket apps, Soft98-style download listings (metadata only), TGJU prices, Iranian crypto exchange prices, Milli.gold gold prices, Tehran Stock Exchange data, ten news sites, Iranian earthquakes, the qavanin.ir laws database the tax administration's public services, Emalls, Mobile.ir and Zoomit prices, Sheypoor ads, Bama, Karnameh and Hamrah Mechanic car prices, Alibaba and Eghamat24 travel, Neshan and Balad maps, Darukade pharmacy, Iranketab books, Faradars courses, Jobinja, Jobvision, IranTalent, Quera (plus iran-jobs-mcp for three job sites side by side), Ponisha and Karlancer jobs and freelance work, Codal filings, Mofid and Agah broker data, BimeBazar and Azki insurance quotes, the Rasmio company registry, Fara Bourse bonds, Fipiran funds, the Iran Mercantile Exchange, Central Bank and Statistical Centre data, Varzesh3 sports, Gamefa, the Time.ir calendar, the Official Gazette and Iranian cloud status, plus PayPing and Bale for the user's own accounts, all unofficial and open source; ExirYab's official server for its doctor directory; Pasavard's official hosted server for hourly-tracked Digikala and Snappshop prices (no sign-in, affiliate links); and SwapWallet's official hosted server for the user's own crypto wallet, where swaps, transfers and withdrawals need the user's approval in Telegram. Prices in Toman. Site servers are read-only. Run any package server with `uvx <name>-mcp`; add Pasavard (`https://pasavard.ir/api/mcp`) and SwapWallet (`https://swapwallet.app/mcp`, OAuth sign-in) by URL. Also a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`iran-mcp`): `claude plugin install <name> --marketplace sepehr071/iran-mcp`, one plugin per server (MCP server + skill) plus bundles such as `iran-all`. Skills for other agents: `npx skills add sepehr071/iran-mcp`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/AGENTS.md): which server for which task, rules, install
- [TOOLS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/TOOLS.md): every tool with a one-line summary
- [servers.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/servers.json): machine-readable catalog (package, version, env vars, tools)
- [.mcp.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/.mcp.json): config for all servers
- [marketplace.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Claude Code plugin marketplace, one plugin per server plus bundles
- [PLUGINS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/PLUGINS.md): plugins and skills, agent compatibility, update flow
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/README.md): overview (English)
- [README.fa.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sepehr071/iran-mcp/main/README.fa.md): overview (Persian)

## Servers

- [digikala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/digikala-mcp): Digikala, Iran's largest online store
- [torob-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/torob-mcp): Torob price comparison: every Iranian shop's price for a product, price history, deal checks
- [basalam-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/basalam-mcp): Basalam marketplace of small shops: products, cheapest offers, shops, reviews
- [technolife-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/technolife-mcp): Technolife electronics, cash and installment prices
- [masterkala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/masterkala-mcp): MasterKala gadgets and accessories
- [shopino-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/shopino-mcp): Shopino fashion marketplace
- [banimode-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/banimode-mcp): Banimode fashion: prices, sizes in stock, reviews, flash sales
- [baneh-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/baneh-mcp): Baneh (baaneeh.com) in-stock home appliances, TVs and tools: cheapest price, brands, reviews
- [divar-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/divar-mcp): Divar classified ads: homes, cars, phones, fair-price checks
- [khanoumi-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/khanoumi-mcp): Khanoumi cosmetics and perfume
- [asalbanoo-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/asalbanoo-mcp): Asal Banoo cosmetics and hair care
- [snapp-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/snapp-mcp): Snappfood food delivery and SnappMarket groceries (snappfood.ir, snapp.market)
- [okala-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/okala-mcp): Okala groceries from nearby stores
- [tapsifood-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tapsifood-mcp): Tapsi Food dishes and restaurants, menus, flash deals
- [mrbilit-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/mrbilit-mcp): MrBilit flights, trains, buses, taxis, hotels
- [flytoday-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/flytoday-mcp): Flytoday flights, trains, buses, hotels, villas, CIP, eSIM, visas
- [jabama-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/jabama-mcp): Jabama stays, tours, events (jabama.com, jabama.tours, jabama.events)
- [shab-mcp](https://github.com/mohamadreza-rezaei/shab-mcp): Shab stays, read-only search and availability
- [otaghak-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/otaghak-mcp): Otaghak villas and cottages
- [paziresh24-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/paziresh24-mcp): Paziresh24 doctors and appointments
- [doctoreto-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/doctoreto-mcp): Doctoreto doctors, clinics, labs
- [exiryab-mcp](https://github.com/sshnevis/exiryab-mcp): ExirYab doctor directory, official (find a doctor by name, city, specialty; clinics, phones, hours, map)
- [taaghche-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/taaghche-mcp): Taaghche ebooks and audiobooks
- [fidibo-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/fidibo-mcp): Fidibo ebooks and audiobooks
- [30book-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/30book-mcp): 30book printed books
- [maktabkhooneh-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/maktabkhooneh-mcp): Maktabkhooneh Persian online courses: search, free and cheapest courses, deals, curricula, reviews (tools `mkh_*`)
- [iran-apps-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-apps-mcp): Android apps on Cafe Bazaar and Myket: search, compare across both stores, top lists
- [iran-downloads-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-downloads-mcp): metadata-only search of Soft98, P30Download, Downloadly and VGDL (item page links, never download links)
- [tgju-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tgju-mcp): TGJU live gold, coin, currency and crypto prices with daily history
- [iran-crypto-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-crypto-mcp): Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin, Ramzinex, Tabdeal, OMPFinex and Exir public market data in Toman: price comparison, order books, trades, candles, top movers
- [milligold-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/milligold-mcp): Milli.gold live 18k gold price, history, fees, trade cost quotes, news and help articles, platform statistics
- [iran-gold-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-gold-mcp): live 18k gold buy and sell prices per gram on Milli.gold, Wallgold, Melligold, Daric and Taline in Toman, cheapest to buy and best to sell
- [tsetmc-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/tsetmc-mcp): Tehran Stock Exchange and Iran Fara Bourse (tsetmc.com) quotes, movers, order book, history, indices, real versus legal trading (prices in Rial)
- [iran-news-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-news-mcp): news from Mehr, Khabaronline, Hamshahri, Tabnak, Entekhab, Asriran, Zoomit, Digiato, Varzesh3, Khabarvarzeshi: headlines, search, full article text
- [iran-quake-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-quake-mcp): earthquakes in Iran from USGS, EMSC and IRSC: latest, strongest, history, stats
- [qavanin-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/qavanin-mcp): qavanin.ir national laws database: search, full text, articles, amendments
- [iran-tax-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-tax-mcp): tax administration public services (tax.gov.ir, stuffid.tax.gov.ir, regulation.tax.gov.ir): e-invoice goods IDs and VAT, activity codes, property values, tax laws and circulars
- [emalls-ir-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/emalls-ir-mcp): Emalls price comparison: products, every shop's offer, price history
- [mobile-ir-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/mobile-ir-mcp): Mobile.ir phone specs, shop prices, price history, used phones, SIM numbers
- [zoomit-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/zoomit-mcp): Zoomit products (Zoobin): phone, laptop and GPU specs, shop prices, price history
- [sheypoor-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/sheypoor-mcp): Sheypoor classified ads, ad details, price summaries for cars and homes
- [bama-ir-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/bama-ir-mcp): Bama car ads, market prices, new-car price lists
- [karnameh-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/karnameh-mcp): Karnameh used-car ads, specs, new-car market prices and price history
- [hamrah-mechanic-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/hamrah-mechanic-mcp): Hamrah Mechanic daily car prices, used cars for sale, inspection fees
- [alibaba-ir-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/alibaba-ir-mcp): Alibaba flights, trains, buses, hotels, villas and tours
- [eghamat24-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/eghamat24-mcp): Eghamat24 hotels: room prices, price calendar, deals, reviews
- [neshan-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/neshan-mcp): Neshan map: places, nearby, reverse geocoding, air quality, car, bike, walking and transit directions
- [balad-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/balad-mcp): Balad map: places, nearby, places along a route, driving directions with live traffic
- [darukade-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/darukade-mcp): Darukade online pharmacy: products, prices, ingredients, reviews
- [iranketab-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iranketab-mcp): Iranketab printed books: translations compared, ratings, reviews, prices
- [faradars-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/faradars-mcp): Faradars Persian online courses: prices, syllabus, instructors
- [jobinja-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/jobinja-mcp): Jobinja job ads, companies, salary stats
- [jobvision-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/jobvision-mcp): Jobvision job ads, companies, advertised pay, interview reports
- [irantalent-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/irantalent-mcp): IranTalent job ads, companies, employee reviews, salary reports
- [quera-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/quera-mcp): Quera tech jobs, companies, contests, problems, courses
- [ponisha-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/ponisha-mcp): Ponisha freelance projects, bids, freelancers, skill demand
- [karlancer-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/karlancer-mcp): Karlancer freelance projects, freelancers, services
- [iran-cloud-status-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-cloud-status-mcp): status, incidents, maintenance and prices of ArvanCloud, Hamravesh, Chabokan and Liara
- [codal-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/codal-mcp): Codal filings of listed companies: financial statements, EPS, monthly activity reports (amounts in Rial)
- [ifb-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/ifb-mcp): Iran Fara Bourse bond and sukuk yields, treasury bills, IPOs, announcements (Rial)
- [fipiran-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/fipiran-mcp): Fipiran mutual funds and ETFs: NAV, returns, size, managers
- [ime-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/ime-mcp): Iran Mercantile Exchange trades, supply offers, prices, market totals (Rial)
- [cbi-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/cbi-mcp): Central Bank of Iran official exchange rates, inflation, policy rates, news (Rial)
- [amar-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/amar-mcp): Statistical Centre of Iran: CPI inflation, unemployment, population, GDP
- [varzesh3-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/varzesh3-mcp): Varzesh3 live scores, league tables, fixtures, teams, transfers, news
- [gamefa-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/gamefa-mcp): Gamefa game and film news, reviews with scores, upcoming releases
- [iran-vod-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/iran-vod-mcp): Filimo and Namava films and series: search, where to watch, details, episodes, new releases
- [time-ir-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/time-ir-mcp): Time.ir calendar: Jalali, Gregorian and Hijri dates, holidays, events, prayer times
- [rrk-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/rrk-mcp): Official Gazette of Iran (rrk.ir): laws, regulations and rulings
- [payping-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/payping-mcp): PayPing merchant account (token, can write)
- [bale-mcp](https://github.com/sepehr071/bale-mcp): Bale messenger bot (token, can write)
- [pasavard-mcp](https://github.com/ashkancapella/pasavard-mcp): Pasavard hourly-tracked Digikala and Snappshop prices, official and hosted (no sign-in; affiliate and cashback links)
- [swapwallet-mcp](https://github.com/SwapWallet/swapwallet-mcp): SwapWallet crypto account, official and hosted (OAuth sign-in; swaps, transfers and withdrawals need Telegram approval)
